research_question: Can the 17 remaining annual characteristics that require market-value scaling, industry adjustment, or CPI-recursive organization capital be reconstructed from the frozen WRDS and BLS sources?

cpi_source.aggregation: calendar-year arithmetic mean of monthly observations

timing_rule: Use the existing annual point-in-time assignment in the research master with no additional monthly lag.
orientation_rule: For each feature compare only the published raw formula and its sign reversal on 2000-2009; select the orientation with positive and larger median monthly Spearman. Do not alter magnitudes, industry definitions, CPI series, recursion, or formulas.
stopping_rule: Judge each feature separately on 2010-2019 exactly once. Failures require a source-backed later version; do not add formula candidates after confirmation.
